title: Critical Friends Episode 28: On Literary SFF
author: Ryan Elliott, Roseanna Pendlebury, Dan Hartland
summary: In this episode of Critical Friends , the Strange Horizons criticism podcast, Dan Hartland is joined by Ryan Elliot and Rosanna Pendlebury, to ask questions about literary SFF. What is it? How do we know it when we see it? And what’s it good for?
